symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1182 (v0.23.0, Mendix 11.12.2): "SET Caption wrote Dutch, and restating the snippet deleted the other languages" — alter snippet … set (Caption: …) on a button whose caption stores nl_NL before en_US (default en_US) wrote the English into nl_NL; create or replace snippet with new English and an inserted widget dropped nl_NL
cause: Already fixed on main before the report was triaged: SET by 33249a36 (setTextsTextTranslation writes model.AuthoringLanguage's entry instead of the first listed one), restate by CarryTranslations' owning-element pairing (#705). Neither had a test with the default language listed SECOND, or with source and shape changed together, so the reported shape was unpinned
insight: Check the reported version before writing a fix: `git fetch --depth=1 <upstream> refs/tags/vX:refs/tags/up-vX`, build it in a worktree, and run the same script against both binaries — that turned a vague report into two exact before/after BSON dumps in minutes. The nl_NL-first shape is built in MDL by authoring under a nl_NL default, adding en_US with `create or modify translations … for en_US`, then switching the default (translations INTO the default are refused). Tests whose default language is absent or listed first cannot distinguish 'write the default' from 'write Items[0]'; put the default second. v0.23.0's old MDL dialect (no `mdl 1;`, `set Caption = …`) needs its own copy of the script.
